cases.name: Janet Lee Lucas
cases.about: Her family said Janet had a contagious smile, warm personality and wore her heart on her sleeve.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED
cases.narrative: When officials couldn't identify her, she became known as “Christy Crystal Creek,” after the area where her body was found. She had been shot twice in the head and her remains were found by a bear hunter.
